footnotes.text: The map translates every pointer - including random pointers that jump backwards or to nodes not yet visited. That's why all copies are created in a first pass.

steps.t: Maps each original node to its copy. None maps to None, so missing links need no special case.
Pass 1: create a copy of node 7 (no links yet).

Pass 2: the copy of 7 gets next → 13 and random → None.
Pass 2: the copy of 13 gets next → 11 and random → 7.
Pass 2: the copy of 11 gets next → 10 and random → 10.
Pass 2: the copy of 10 gets next → None and random → 13.

footnotes.text: Interleaving puts every copy at original.next, so "copy of X" is just X.next - the hash map is replaced by the list itself. O(1) extra space.
